newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $1.681 bln net inflow in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $1.681 bln net inflow in Oct.

text.p: Brazil's commercial and financial foreign exchange transactions showed a preliminary surplus of $1.681 billion in October in the forex commercial market, against a $875 million surplus in September, bankers said.
Higher dollar inflows were mostly due to a sharp increase in financial buy operations, dealers said.
Financial buy deals totalled $6.596 billion in October, according to Central Bank data supplied to banks. Financial sell operations amounted to $4.408 billion last month.
Dealers said October contracted exports were $3.654 billion against $4.161 billion in import operations.
